I opened a PR on Prysm for the endpoint. If that format works for you guys let's open it in the API that works, we can further discuss on the PR https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/608 I think i addressed all open feedback on this so far, how do people feel about this? one thing remains is if we want to just completely remove the get proposer preferences call yeah why is it there? it's not a "pool" in the usual sense and a client not acting as a builder doesn't need it as an externally accessible builder, rather (not self-build) I can only see it useful for debugging, or if a builder wants to pull proposer preferences from there instead of listening to the sse event i guess then it would be under debug? is that useful enough to keep? why have it at all? `debug` is as hard to turn off as anything because of the checkpoint sync stuff ok i mean i can remove it, i don't have strong feelings for it `debug` isn't real, hasn't been since Jacek force the undoing of the move of getStateV2 back into `debug` some years ago my default would be no if nobody wants it, we can always add it later, <@1386598056320831509> can you ask builders about this and this is exactly the trap that sets it seems more casual to add to `debug` but it's not i'm leaning towards removing for now and adding if needed in a spearate pr we can wait for feedback from builders ok i'll just get it ready locally

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: no, optional isn't an SSZ type. also, fork-choice stores are not an SSZ object... it's a regular python object not an SSZ Container

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: we have optional in our ssz lib 😄

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: but I think what potuz meant is encode the fork choice dump as ssz instead of json, which already right now (pre-gloas) is not possible

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: there is no SSZ schema for the fork choice endpoint, yeah, it's defined as json only

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: you cna't right now as it returns enums (`validity`) and has this arbitrary `extra_data` field

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: let's first get unbounded lists to fix the deposits SSZ cap, and to enable nested lists without requiring hundreds of hashes when there is even just a single element in it 🙂 so far only lodestar and nimbus have it.
